name: Barbarian
description: A fearless warrior with a yellow mustache, a sword, and a strong desire to smash buildings and enemies.

name: Archer
description: A skilled female warrior who attacks enemies from a distance using her bow and arrows.

name: Goblin
description: A greedy green creature that prioritizes stealing Gold, Elixir, and Dark Elixir from enemy villages.

name: Giant
description: A massive warrior who focuses on destroying defensive buildings before attacking other structures.

name: Wall Breaker
description: A living skeleton carrying an explosive bomb that sacrifices itself to break through enemy walls.

name: Balloon
description: A skeleton piloting a flying hot-air balloon that drops powerful bombs on enemy defenses.

name: Wizard
description: A powerful magic user who launches fireballs at enemies and buildings from a distance.

name: Healer
description: A flying support unit that heals friendly ground troops with magical healing powers.

name: Dragon
description: A mighty flying creature that breathes fire and deals devastating damage to enemy buildings and troops.

name: P.E.K.K.A
description: A heavily armored warrior with enormous strength and a powerful sword capable of dealing massive damage.

name: Baby Dragon
description: A small but fierce flying dragon that becomes enraged and stronger when no other air troops are nearby.

name: Miner
description: An underground fighter who travels beneath the battlefield, avoiding damage while moving toward enemy buildings.

name: Electro Dragon
description: A gigantic electric dragon that releases lightning bolts capable of chaining between multiple enemy targets.

name: Yeti
description: A powerful furry creature that carries tiny Yetimites, which jump out and attack nearby enemies and defenses.

name: Root Rider
description: A mysterious forest warrior riding a massive root creature that smashes through walls and helps allied troops move across the battlefield.
